items.stem:
(a) What do the many examples of resistance tell us about Mughal power? (3 marks)
(b) Why is Maharana Pratap remembered in Indian history? (2 marks)
items.answer: (a) (1) Mughal control was never complete across India. (2) Regional powers valued their independence. (3) Terrain and local support helped smaller states resist a large army. (b) (1) He refused to accept Mughal overlordship. (2) He kept fighting from the hills after Haldighati and recovered much of Mewar.

(2) He kept fighting from the hills after Haldighati and recovered much of Mewar.
